newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine Feb industrial production seen up 8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Argentine Feb industrial production seen up 8 pct.

text.p: Argentine industrial production in February will rise a little more than eight percent from the same month in 1996, according to economists' forecasts.
The February figures are due to be released Wednesday by the FIEL private consultancy.
The average of the estimates predicts a rise of 8.28 percent in industrial production. Forecasts ranged from a high of 10.4 percent to a low of 4.8 percent.
For more information, see RPLTAQ and RPLATR.
